theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ R : Euclid d → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d), ContinuousOn R V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, (R y).comp (fderiv ℝ ψ y) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d)
